messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000321": The catalog service calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the catalog service.  (about: image resizer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000272": As of 2025-03-20, the image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000721": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000724" [decision]: Decision on 2025-10-07: after INC-2025-023, reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000329" [decision]: Decision on 2025-04-17: the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000345": The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000703": As of 2025-09-23, the Dune team noticed that the bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000601": As of 2025-08-19, the Dune team observed that after the runtime upgrade, the resizer's cold start time tripled.  (about: Dune team, the resizer)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000713" [preference]: As of 2025-09-30, the Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000717": INC-2025-023 affected the indexer, which served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000557": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team for the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000729": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
Existing entity names: image resizer, catalog service, Ember team, Atlas team, Cinder, indexer, billing API, INC-2025-023, OpenSearch 2.11, Boreal team, ledger service, Dune team, the bus, authentication gateway, the resizer, webhook dispatcher, notifier, Priya Raman, Tomasz, notification service
